name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS)

controls.title: Network Security Controls & Boundary Configuration
controls.description: Network security controls (NSCs) are configured and maintained to restrict traffic between untrusted and trusted networks.
controls.mappingRationale: Verifies that ingress points cannot route directly into cardholder data environments without firewall / ALB boundary controls.

controls.title: Direct Public Access to Cardholder Data Prohibited
controls.description: Direct public access between the internet and any system in the cardholder data environment (CDE) is prohibited.
controls.mappingRationale: Detects any public S3 bucket, exposed database, or direct ingress into assets classified as containing payment data.

controls.title: Public-Facing Web Applications Protected Against Attacks
controls.description: Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks, including injection and SSRF.
controls.mappingRationale: Inspects endpoints and web workloads for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities including SSRF and SQL injection.

controls.title: Least Privilege Access Control to Cardholder Data
controls.description: Access to system components and data is appropriately segregated and defined by least privilege.
controls.mappingRationale: Checks for wildcard IAM grants (*:* or s3:*) allowing broad read/write access to sensitive storage.

controls.title: Identification & Authentication Credentials Managed
controls.description: User and system authentication credentials and secrets are securely generated, stored, and managed.
controls.mappingRationale: Flags plaintext API keys, database credentials, or private signing keys hardcoded in source code or IaC.

controls.title: Physical Security Controls at Facility Entrances
controls.description: Physical security controls prevent unauthorized physical access to systems containing cardholder data.
controls.mappingRationale: NOT OBSERVABLE: Data center cage locks, visitor logs, and video surveillance systems cannot be inspected by static code/graph analysis.

controls.title: Personnel Screening & Background Inquiries
controls.description: Personnel with access to the CDE are screened prior to hire to reduce the risk of insider threats.
controls.mappingRationale: NOT OBSERVABLE: Background checks and employment history verification are administrative HR functions.
